desc:
BEASTS is a wobbly game where you punch, grab, headbutt and dropkick your way to victory!

Knock beasts out, lift them over your head and toss them off the map. Last beast standing wins!

Fight on chaotic maps: hang on to speeding trucks, dodge sharks on floating ice, escape the giant octopus in the aquarium, survive the incinerator, ride the ferris wheel and more. Vote for the next map between rounds!

Dress up your beast: win rounds to earn coins and unlock onesies, hats and accessories like the Unicorn, Dino, Shark, Panda and Chicken.

Daily rewards, levels, win streaks and leaderboards.

Play on computer, phone, tablet and console.

Click to punch. Hold to grab. Grab and jump to climb. Lift knocked out beasts and throw them!
